system.title: System
pack.title: Pack {n}
settings.hw.title: Supported hardware
settings.hw.note: Each pack reports its own firmware version (for example 16.06.13), shown as "Firmware" in HA.
settings.saved: Saved. The add-on restarts the connection now.
settings.prefilled: The number of packs was set to {n} from the detection. It is not saved yet.
settings.f.transport.label: Connection type
settings.f.transport.help: How the add-on reaches the RS485 bus: through an RS485-to-Ethernet gateway or a serial device of this machine.
settings.f.host.label: Gateway address
settings.f.host.help: IP address or host name of the RS485-to-Ethernet device, for example a Waveshare gateway.
settings.f.port.label: Gateway port
settings.f.device.label: Serial device
settings.f.device.help: Absolute path of the serial device, for example /dev/ttyUSB0.
settings.f.baud.label: Baud rate
settings.f.baud.help: Automatic means 19200 for a single pack (RS485-1/2) and 9600 for multiple packs (CAN port). Firmware 16.04.x needs 9600 on RS485-1/2 as well.
settings.f.pack_count.label: Number of packs
settings.f.pack_count.help: Total number of battery packs, 1 to 16 (1 = single pack, 2 or more = master and slaves). The detection tab can find it out.
settings.f.maint_firmware.label: Read MAINT custom firmware data
settings.f.maint_firmware.help: Also read the extra data of the MAINT 1.5.4 / 1.6.4 custom firmware where a pack reports it. Read-only; packs with OEM firmware are not affected.
settings.f.update_interval.label: Update interval
settings.f.update_interval.help: Seconds between two polling cycles (0 = continuously).
settings.f.bus.label: Bus
settings.f.bus.help: Where the add-on reads the pack. Several packs are always read on the RS485 pins of the CAN socket; a single pack can be read on either.
settings.f.bus_quiet_ms.label: Bus quiet
settings.f.bus_quiet_ms.help: Wait time without bus traffic before each request (200–2000 ms). The packs recognize the end of a frame only after about 100 ms of silence; 200 ms leave a safe margin. Longer values slow each poll round, so Home Assistant stores fewer data points. While the OpenBMS Monitor feed is on, 200 ms apply.
settings.f.min_cell_voltage.label: Minimum cell voltage
settings.f.min_cell_voltage.help: Lower end of the cell voltage range. Only used for display ranges, not read from the BMS.
settings.f.max_cell_voltage.label: Maximum cell voltage
settings.f.max_cell_voltage.help: Upper end of the cell voltage range. Only used for display ranges, not read from the BMS.
settings.f.nominal_cell_voltage.label: Nominal cell voltage
settings.f.nominal_cell_voltage.help: Nominal voltage of one cell (LFP: 3.2). Used for the calculated full energy of the packs and the system.
invalid.type: This is not a valid number.

invalid.format: This value has an invalid format.

invalid.unknown_field: This field is not part of the cell database format.
sets.intro: A parallel set is a group of packs that share one common feeder. For every active set the add-on combines the values of its packs (current, power, state of charge, voltage and cell extremes) and offers them as a device in Home Assistant. Sets are only evaluated with several packs. Nothing is written to the BMS.
sets.single_pack_hint: Only one pack is configured, so every set is inactive. Set the number of packs in the settings first.
sets.empty: No sets yet. Add one or let the add-on propose neighbour pairs.
sets.proposed: {n} set(s) proposed. Check them, then save.
sets.propose_none: No free neighbour pair: the packs are already in a set.
sets.saved: Saved. The values appear after the next poll cycle.
sets.fix_errors: Some values are invalid. See the marked fields.
sets.name.label: Name
sets.name.help: 1 to 40 characters, different for every set.
sets.members.label: Member packs, in physical order
sets.members.help: Packs can only be in one set. Order them as they are wired, for example along the busbar.
sets.members.none: No packs yet. A set needs at least two.
sets.wiring.label: Wiring
sets.wiring.diagonal.help: The plus and the minus cable of the bank are connected at different packs. Choose the pack of each tap.
sets.wiring.common_busbar.help: All packs are connected to one common busbar. The taps are optional.
sets.wiring.unknown.help: The wiring is not known. The values are calculated the same way.
sets.plus.label: Plus tap
sets.minus.label: Minus tap
sets.taps.help: The packs that carry the plus and the minus cable of the bank. Required for diagonal wiring.
sets.reason.single_pack: Inactive: sets need several packs, but only one pack is configured.
sets.reason.pack_not_configured: Inactive: a member pack is not among the configured packs.
guard.text: There are unsaved changes in the settings.
restart.waiting: Applying the new connection: the add-on is restarting. This can take a moment …
restart.slow: The restart takes longer than expected.
detect.explain: Scans the addresses 0 to 15 with a read-only identity request, one address per poll cycle, so it takes about 16 poll cycles. Normal polling continues meanwhile. Nothing is changed automatically.
detect.no_master: No pack answered at address 00, so no bank can be derived.
detect.differs: {n} pack(s) found from address 0, but {saved} are saved.
job.state.queued: Waiting for the next poll cycle
cells.intro: Cell types describe the datasheet limits of a cell. The bundled types cannot be changed; you can add your own types, copy a bundled type as a template, and import or export them as JSON. Nothing is written to the BMS.
cells.search.help: Manufacturer, model, variant or capacity in Ah.
cells.conflict.text: A newer bundled catalog also contains the id {id}. Your type keeps working, but rename it to see the bundled one.
cells.delete.confirm: Delete the cell type {name}? This cannot be undone.
cells.gone: This cell type no longer exists.
cells.rename.help: Choose a new id for your type {id}. Packs that use it follow the new id.
cells.stale: The settings changed meanwhile, so the page was reloaded. Your edit was not applied.
cells.in_use: {id} is still assigned to {packs}. Unassign it first.
cells.rate.help: Rates are relative: C times the nominal capacity in Ah, P times the nominal energy in Wh divided by the nominal voltage.
cells.derating.C: Maximum continuous charge rate as a multiple of the nominal capacity (C).
cells.derating.P: Maximum continuous charge rate as a multiple of the nominal power (P).
cells.derating.lower: Between two points the lower value applies; outside the table charging is not allowed.
cells.derating.linear: Between two points the value is interpolated linearly (the datasheet allows it).
cells.form.help: Fields marked * are required. Values the form does not show stay as they are. Saving an edit raises the entry version; packs keep their stored copy until you accept the update.
cells.form.preserved: All other schema fields (rates, derating table, provenance, …) are kept unchanged.
cells.form.id.help: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Cannot be changed later except by renaming.
cells.form.datasheet.title: Document title
cells.import.bad_json: The file is not valid JSON.
cells.import.not_array: The file must contain a JSON array of cell entries (OpenBMS format).
packs.intro: Assign a cell type to every pack. The add-on then checks the measured values and the BMS settings against the datasheet. Nothing is written to the BMS.
packs.parallel.help: Whole number from 1. The series count is measured and cannot be entered.
packs.parallel.suggest: Suggestion: {n} in parallel (rated capacity {rated} ÷ {nominal} per cell).
packs.update.text: A newer version of the assigned cell type is available. Changed: {fields}
packs.mismatch.text: The BMS serial number differs from the one stored with the assignment. Checks and the balancer state are paused. Confirm if this is the same pack, or assign again.
packs.invalid: The stored assignment is not valid. Choose a cell type again.
packs.apply_all.confirm: Copy cell type, parallel count and balancer profile of {source} to: {packs}? The changes are only saved when you save.
packs.apply_all.done: Copied to {n} pack(s). Review and save.
packs.saved: Saved. The checks appear after the next poll cycle.
packs.stale: The settings changed meanwhile (for example by the identity guard), so the page was reloaded. Your edits were not applied.
check.reason.pending: Saved, checked after the current polling cycle.
check.reason.serial_mismatch: The BMS serial number changed; confirm the pack first.
check.reason.invalid_snapshot: The stored assignment is not valid.
check.reason.stale_sample: The last measurement is too old.
check.reason.no_parameters: The BMS settings are not readable.
check.reason.stale_parameters: The BMS settings were not refreshed recently.
check.reason.missing_limit: The datasheet has no limit for this.
check.reason.no_series: The series count is not known.
check.reason.near_charge_cutoff: Close to the charge cut-off voltage.
check.reason.near_discharge_cutoff: Close to the discharge cut-off voltage.
check.reason.near_range_edge: Close to the edge of the temperature range.
check.reason.charge_not_allowed: Charging is not allowed at this temperature.
check.reason.rated_capacity_mismatch: Differs from nominal capacity × parallel by more than 2 %.
check.reason.series_mismatch: Differs from the measured series count.
profiles.title: Balancer profiles
profiles.intro: A profile describes the values of an external active balancer (millivolts). The add-on calculates from the cell voltages whether it is active; it does not talk to the balancer.
profiles.in_use: A profile is still assigned to {packs}. Unassign it first.
profiles.f.name: Name
profiles.f.name.help: 1 to 40 characters, different for every profile.
profiles.f.trigger_mv.help: Required, 1 to 5000. The balancer starts when highest minus lowest cell reaches this.
profiles.f.stop_mv.help: Optional. Empty or not below the start value: no hysteresis.
profiles.f.start_mv.help: Optional. The highest cell must be at least this high.
profiles.f.stop_cell_mv.help: Optional. Ignored without a start cell voltage.
profiles.f.when.help: When the balancer is allowed to work.

feed.title: OpenBMS Monitor feed
feed.switch: Publish the raw measurements for OpenBMS Monitor
feed.hint_on: Feed active. The round pause is 0 for now; the bus quiet is 200 ms. Your stored settings are kept. Current round: {s} s. The add-on keeps no archive.
feed.hint_off: When on, the add-on also publishes every answer with its read time, so OpenBMS Monitor can analyse the bank over MQTT without polling it a second time. Polling gets faster while it is on (round pause 0, bus quiet 200 ms).
err.feed_unavailable: The feed cannot be switched right now.
